payload.title: Correlating two GeoSeries
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook is designed to compute the correlation between two GeoSeries. It utilizes the pyleoclim library to handle paleoclimate data and perform the necessary transformations and calculations. The notebook fetches data from a specified URL using SPARQL queries to extract relevant paleoclimate datasets. The data is then processed and converted into a format suitable for correlation analysis. The final output is the computed correlation between the two GeoSeries.
goals: Transform data into a suitable format for analysis

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook focuses on computing the correlation between two GeoSeries. It involves fetching paleoclimate data using SPARQL queries, processing the data, and performing correlation analysis using the pyleoclim library.
section_blurbs.heading: Correlating two GeoSeries

inputs: Paleoclimate datasets from a specified URL
